instruction: Place an order for everything in my amazon cart and wishlist for my home address.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The order must contain every cart product and every wish-list product with their full quantities, delivered to the amazon address named Home; no address may be updated/deleted. Plan: get passwords, log in, review cart, review wish list, move each wish-list product into the cart (default quantity moves the whole wish-list quantity; if the product is already in the cart the quantities add up), look up the Home address id and a payment card id, place one order, complete the task. The number of wish-list entries is unknown a priori; the problem assumes 3 (matching the 11-call reference solution). 'All wish-list products moved' is encoded with a STRIPS counter (count objects n0..n3, count-pred, count-zero): each move decrements wish-list-count and place-order requires it to be zero; the extra count parameters are bookkeeping, not API arguments. place-order is restricted to the home address, so the goal (order-placed-to address-home) is reached only after the wish list is emptied into the cart. supervisor-complete-task takes the delivery address as a record parameter so its precondition mirrors the goal; complete_task is called with no answer. Cart products are listed only to document the initial cart contents; they are never API arguments.
